author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Just one random data point.  I had lunch with my friend working at a S&P500 tech company.  I asked how much is his company's tokens budget.

$5000 per month.

That is probably not the norm, let's say cut 80%.  That is still $1000 of tokens per employee per month from every single company, that's is a lot of money.  The AI bubble is still in the early phase, far from popping.
